name: Polar Scoop ice cream agent
organization: Polar Scoop (fictional ice cream shop, hackathon demo)
description: Agent of Polar Scoop, a FICTIONAL ice cream shop built for a hackathon. Ask about flavours, prices and opening hours, or place a pickup order. Sandbox only: no real shop, no real payments. The agent replies when it is your turn (task state INPUT_REQUIRED) and finishes with COMPLETED or REJECTED.

skill.name: Ice cream questions and pickup orders
skill.description: Answers questions about the fictional Polar Scoop shop (flavours, prices, hours) and takes simple pickup orders. Multi-turn.
examples: How much is one scoop of pistachio?
I'd like two scoops of chocolate in a cone for pickup at 3 pm.
